lens_shading_gain — GFX2D isp op

• Data kinds: image2d → image2d

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.lens_shading_gain(flat, pattern=None, smooth_sigma=0.0) (implementation को सीधे call करना हो तो import gfx2d; gfx2d.lens_shading_gain(flat, pattern=None, smooth_sigma=0.0), registry से लेना हो तो opsgfx2d.get("lens_shading_gain"))

उपयोग

flat-field frame को समतल करने वाला gain map: हर colour channel के लिए gain = mean / flat (या *pattern* None हो तो पूरे frame के लिए)।

> नीचे का विस्तृत विवरण मूल text में है — सारांश और headings का अनुवाद हो चुका है।

Shoot a uniform white target; vignetting and the micro-lens fall-off make the corners darker. Multiplying any later frame by this map undoes that. *smooth_sigma* > 0 Gaussian-smooths the flat first (per channel) so sensor noise and dust do not become gain speckle. The gain is normalised so the channel mean stays 1 — the map corrects shape, not exposure.

Ground truth: lens_shading_correct(flat, lens_shading_gain(flat)) is a constant frame (each channel equal to its own mean) to 1e-12. Raises ValueError: non-finite input, a zero or negative pixel in the flat (no gain can be defined there), or a negative *smooth_sigma*.
